newsitem.title: DENMARK: Carlsberg confirms considering Egyptian project.
newsitem.headline: Carlsberg confirms considering Egyptian project.

text.p: Danish brewery giant Carlsberg A/S confirmed on Monday its intention to participate in a possible brewery project in Egypt in cooperation with a local brewer, but said no deal had yet been signed.

"Carlsberg wants to confirm that it does intend to take part in a possible brewery project in Egypt with the local brewer even if no actual deal has been made yet," Carlsberg information chief Monica Ritterband told Reuters.
The brewery was commenting on media reports that it signed a deal with U.S. Luxor investment group to participate in a brewery project in Egypt with local Al Ahram Beverages Company (ABC).

"Carlsberg has made no deal with Luxor Group on building a brewery or making a licensing deal for our beer in Egypt with ABC. We have only approved that Luxor in their prospectus mention such a project as a possibility," she added.
Ritterband declined to make any further comment.
U.S. Luxor Group acquired last year a 75 percent holding in ABC, Egypt's sole brewer.
